description: This file defines a BottomSheet UI component for Android, including its layout, behavior, actions, and builder pattern for configuration.

classes.name: BottomSheet
classes.description: A BottomSheetDialogFragment subclass that creates a customizable bottom sheet with header and actions.

classes.name: BottomSheet.Action
classes.description: A Parcelable data class representing an action in the bottom sheet, including title, icon, and click behavior.

classes.name: BottomSheet.Builder
classes.description: A builder class to construct and configure a BottomSheet with multiple actions.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the view hierarchy for the bottom sheet, including header and actions.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the bottom sheet behavior to be expanded when shown.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Static method to display the bottom sheet with specified header, actions, and configuration.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Adds an action to the builder with a string title.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Adds an action to the builder with a resource ID title.
